name: Petronas Towers
description: Petronas Towers: Generally refers to the Petronas Twin Towers of Kuala Lumpur. It is located in the northwest corner of the Kuala Lumpur city center (KLCC) planning area. It was once the tallest skyscraper in the world and is still the tallest twin towers in the world. Together with the adjacent Kuala Lumpur Tower, it is a well-known landmark and symbol of Kuala Lumpur. Standing at the Twin Towers, you can overlook the most prosperous scene in Malaysia. The sky bridge of the building's herringbone bracket is uniquely designed, rising high in the sky like a gate to the sky.
